name: 0xferrous
summary: A Zola blog of 0xferrous, source public in 0xferrous/0xferrous.github.io (no licence file). It is not Level 3: its post pages load the utterances comments script from utteranc.es with no integrity hash, third-party code that runs when a post opens. Every page also loads a font from unpkg.com.
